You’ve experienced THX® at world-class cinemas, but you won’t find it in any other vehicle line. The Lincoln
exclusive THX II Certified Audio System2 is specifically designed for the MKZ interior. With 14 strategically
placed speakers and 700 watts of maximum power, feel free to drive to audio nirvana.
Just talk or touch. It responds brilliantly in here, too. SYNC® with MyLincoln TouchTM1 driver-connect technology
puts you in control of life in your car. It operates via simple voice commands and your touch, so your hands stay on
the wheel and your eyes on the road. This system dials numbers and answers calls so you don’t have to pick up
your phone, and it mutes other audio sources so you won’t miss a call. It plays all the music you like from a variety
of sources, and with SYNC Services, it also delivers news and weather. It even navigates for you with turn-by-turn
directions, and locates businesses just by name. Simple 5-way controls on the steering wheel, along with vibrant
LCD gauges and a vivid 8" LCD screen in your center stack, put everything in full view.
